seoTitle: DMARC Record Analyzer: Explain Every Tag in a TXT Value
metaDescription: Paste a DMARC TXT record and get each tag explained, with warnings for p=none, pct below 100 and bad report addresses. Free and local.
intro: Explains each DMARC tag in a pasted record and warns about weak or invalid settings.
why:
A DMARC record controls what receivers do with mail that fails SPF and DKIM alignment, and where they send reports. The syntax is short, but a typo can disable the policy.

Paste the record (quotes and split strings are joined) and see the policy, subdomain policy, percentage, alignment modes and report addresses in plain words. Warnings cover p=none, pct below 100, missing rua, bad URIs and unknown tags. It reads RFC 7489 tags and accepts newer ones without checking. It does not look up DNS.
howTo: Run dig TXT _dmarc.yourdomain or copy the value from DNS.
Read the explanation and the review list.
Move from none to quarantine to reject as reports allow.

faq.a: It only monitors. Nothing is blocked.

faq.q: Why do external report addresses need a record?
faq.a: The receiving domain must authorise reports for yours, otherwise they are not sent.
Use the DMARC Record Generator for that.
